corrections.text: The article states that "The advisories describe a worst case that depends on user interaction and on a local runtime executing a changed file." Only the critical advisory (GHSA-f2ph-cmg5-wxc8) says "With user interaction" and rates user interaction as passive (CVSS v4 UI:P). The high-severity advisory (GHSA-px85-f4q5-jh77) is rated UI:N, with an adjacent-network attack vector, and describes an attacker on the same local network with no user interaction.

The article says both advisories list the storybook package "up to" 8.6.19, 9.1.21, 10.6.2 and 11.0.0-alpha.6. The advisories give exclusive ranges (for example >= 8.0.0, < 8.6.19), so the patched releases themselves are not affected.
